identity.name: Solar Crucible
identity.summary: A broad gold crucible holding a restrained orange flame.
identity.description: Costs 4 mana per activation. Deals 15 magical damage per affordable activation. Applies 5 burn through the existing combat keyword rules per affordable activation.
identity.lore: An astronomer melted a fallen ray of dawn inside it.

effects.description: Costs 4 mana per activation. Deals 15 magical damage per affordable activation. Applies 5 burn through the existing combat keyword rules per affordable activation.
effects.condition: Equipped; class restriction satisfied; all activation costs can be paid together.

synergies.description: Its fire trace participates in the Elementalist's existing reaction system; arrange it with spells of another element. No extra reaction beyond the shared rules is added.

conditions: All ingredients are packed, unlocked, nonpermanent and form one orthogonally connected group.
recipes.failureBehavior: Incomplete, disconnected or locked inputs consume nothing. A complete recipe always consumes its inputs; an output that cannot fit enters the stash.
recipes.description: Combine Kiln Prayer, Moonwell Pebble, Salamander Contract into Solar Crucible.

visual.brief: A broad gold crucible holding a restrained orange flame.
visual.paletteIntent: Restrained material ramps; deliberate spell element colors; no incidental rim light.
definingFeatures: A broad gold crucible holding a restrained orange flame.
